title: Situationship
summary: A situationship is an undefined romantic or sexual connection — more than friends but without clear commitment or labels.
key_points: Often comfortable short-term but confusing if one person wants more; a 'what are we?' talk helps.
answer_guidance: Be warm, practical and neutral rather than preachy. Explain the idea, then offer one or two concrete suggestions if useful. Don't judge the user's partner from limited information.
